Reference stage: 1280 x 720 at world zoom x4, letterboxed in 1366 x 768.GreyscaleColour

Markers

Shape carries the meaning; colour is a second signal. Each marker is an inline SVG symbol with a paper halo and an ink line so it reads on light and dark floors. Open #grey to see the whole page in greyscale.

Conversation

Shape: Speech bubble. A coworker has something to say. Coral.

Over a person's head. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Terminal

Shape: Monitor. A device you can use. Teal.

On or above the device. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Route

Shape: Diamond with a doorway. A path that is open or newly open. Gold.

At the door or shortcut. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Glitch

Shape: Folded page. A repair duel. Violet, glitches only.

Above the glitch. Left: colour. Right: forced greyscale.

Keycap states

Keycaps are DOM components. A held key is teal, sits lower and carries the word "Hold", so no state depends on colour alone.

Calibration: five optional steps3 observed · 1 skipped
1 Caps + H → Left arrow Observed output To walk west, you need to press Left arrow. Hint: it is tap-hold Caps + H.
2 Caps + N → Return Observed output To submit, you need to press Return. Hint: Return is tap-hold Caps + N.
3 Space + A → 1 Observed output To type a one, you need to press 1. Hint: 1 is tap-hold Space + A.
4 Space + Q → ! Not started To type an exclamation mark, you need to press !. Hint: it is tap-hold Space + Q.
5 Shift on the home row → capital J Skipped To type a capital J, you need to press Shift + J. Hint: Shift is tap-hold F, then J.

The number row gives the same 1 and ! as Space + A and Space + Q, so observed output never proves which key you used.

Confidence-aware input feedback

Every result says what the game can know. Observed output is solid teal with an eye; a confirmation is a double paper border with a person and a check; an OS-reserved case is a dashed border with a shield. The wording rules follow game-design acceptance criteria 5 and 6.

Input feedback

Three states, each with its own icon, border and words. Practice layer: player-confirmed Practice layer: unconfirmed

Two layer facts, kept apart The scene is showing: nav (the game's own scene) You said practice is: active (only your word)

Say

  • "Observed output: Option + Right."
  • "You confirmed tap-hold Space + A."
  • "Can't be observed here (OS-reserved)." Then confirm or skip.
  • "Practice layer: player-confirmed / unconfirmed."

Never say

  • You are in the nav layer. Held layers are invisible.
  • You pressed Space + A. Or the number row: same 1.
  • Practice mode detected. It cannot be detected.
  • Failed, for an OS-reserved shortcut.
